__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus datasource scraping the CockroachDB Prometheus endpoint (default :8080 or :26258 for CRDB 23.2+). NOT the Kafka Connect REST API -- native changefeed runs inside CRDB, not Connect.

description: FSI Kafka Platform - CockroachDB native changefeed observability (ADR-012 path A). This dashboard is STRUCTURALLY DIFFERENT from other connector dashboards: native changefeed runs inside CRDB and emits to Kafka without Kafka Connect. Metrics come from the CRDB Prometheus endpoint, not the Connect REST API.

panels.title: Active Changefeed Jobs
panels.description: Currently running CHANGEFEED jobs across the CRDB cluster. SHOW CHANGEFEED JOBS for details.

defaults.noValue: No CRDB Prometheus endpoint configured. Check that DS_PROMETHEUS points at the CRDB cluster, NOT the Confluent cluster.

panels.title: Failed Jobs (last 1h)
panels.description: Changefeed jobs that entered 'failed' state. Inspect via SHOW CHANGEFEED JOBS WHERE status='failed'.

panels.title: Error retries (per minute)
panels.description: Sink errors that triggered retries. Persistent non-zero rate suggests Kafka broker unavailability or auth drift.

panels.title: Emit latency p95 (ms)
panels.description: p95 time from CRDB MVCC commit to Kafka acknowledgement.

panels.title: Emitted messages per second (per changefeed)
panels.description: Events delivered to Kafka, broken down by changefeed job.

panels.title: Checkpoint watermark lag (sec)
panels.description: Time between now and the highest resolved-timestamp emitted. Critical SLA-tier targets 10s; standard 60s.

panels.title: Rangefeed processor load (per CRDB node)
panels.description: The internal CRDB mechanism that feeds changefeeds. Persistent high load = upstream bottleneck before Kafka.

list.label: CRDB Cluster
list.description: CockroachDB cluster ID label (matches the scrape job).
